card.name: Word endings like -orge and -urge
card.fires_on: The ending piece of words spelled with -orge, -urge, -udge or -enge, such as the second half of Gorge. It is strongest on Columbia River Gorge and on names split mid-spelling.

modes.label: Gorge place names
modes.description: The ending of Gorge in river gorge place names.

modes.description: The ending piece of rarer words split into parts, such as skurge, bludgeoned, grudgingly or vengeful.
